raw: {"analysis":"LWF provides a more practical and actionable plan, with clear parallel lanes, specific gates tied to the dual-approval requirement, and a canary deployment strategy that directly addresses the remote-site risk. LKB introduces unnecessary process overhead (G0-G9 gates, LLM token budgets) and contains a subtle contradiction: Lane C says to build the sidecar against 'proposed base layer changes' while the constraint is to not alter the base layer at all. LWF's risk note about pivoting to delta-updates if the target is unreachable shows better awareness of the operational reality.","verdict":"LWF"}
